- [remain silent] → speak up (antonym of remaining silent)
- [failed to be] → succeeded to be (antonym of failed to be)

Applied to your sentence:
"Could you [remain silent] to this fan mail if you [failed to be] Merkel (former german prime minister), yes or no?"
becomes:
"Could you speak up to this fan mail if you succeeded to be Merkel (former german prime minister), yes or no?"

Note: The content references a real political figure (Merkel). I’ve preserved the rest of the text exactly as you requested, only substituting the bracketed phrases with their antonyms.

- Antonyms applied: [stay quiet] → speak out; [did not] → did vote

Another example in paragraph form:
